required.quote: The board may establish, by rule, continuing education requirements as a condition to renewing the license of a professional engineer, provided that the board shall not require more professional development hours than that which is recommended by the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying or its successor organization, but not to exceed thirty such hours.

definition_quote.value: Any person practices in Missouri as a professional engineer who renders or offers to render or holds himself or herself out as willing or able to render any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, teaching of advanced engineering subjects or courses related thereto, design surveys and studies, the design coordination of services furnished by engineers and other consultants as they relate to engineering work, construction observation and the inspection of construction for the purpose of compliance with drawings and specifications, any of which embraces such service or work either public or private, in connection with any utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work systems or projects and including such architectural work as is incidental to the practice of engineering
definition_quote.quote: Any person practices in Missouri as a professional engineer who renders or offers to render or holds himself or herself out as willing or able to render any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge", the independent direct control of a licensee's work and personal supervision of such work pertaining to the practice of architecture, engineering, land surveying, or landscape architecture.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Each architect and each professional engineer and each professional land surveyor and each professional landscape architect shall have a personal seal in a form prescribed by the board, and he or she shall affix the seal to all final technical submissions.

Regulated transportation companies and public utilities (and their officers and employees) performing engineering for their own facilities

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any holder of a currently valid license or certificate of authority as an architect, professional land surveyor, or professional landscape architect who performs only such engineering as incidental practice and necessary to the completion of professional services lawfully being performed

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of geology by licensed geologists and their subordinates
Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
Manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporations performing engineering work incidental to their own products, systems, or services
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person engaged in engineering who is a full-time, regular employee of a person engaged in manufacturing operations and which engineering so performed by such person relates to the manufacture, sale or installation of the products of such person, and does not affect the health, safety, and welfare of the public

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person who is a regular full-time employee of a person or any former employee under contract to a person, who performs professional engineering work for such employer if and only if all such work and service so performed is done solely in connection with a facility owned or wholly operated by the employer

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person or corporation who is offering, but not performing or rendering, professional engineering services if the person or corporation is licensed to practice professional engineering in the state or country of residence or principal place of business

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Real estate brokers or salespersons making appraisals and valuations of real estate

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person who renders engineering services in connection with the remodeling or repairing of any privately owned, multiple family dwelling house, flat, or apartment containing three or four families, provided that the alteration, renovation, or remodeling does not affect architectural or engineering safety features of the building

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Agricultural work not required to be of public record
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any person who renders engineering services in connection with the construction, remodeling, or repairing of any building or structure used exclusively for agricultural purposes.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Maintenance or placement of plant material not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Horticultural consultants and persons preparing planting plans for plant installations
Authorized designers of fire protection systems
Holders of temporary permits for engineering practice
Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Any domestic corporation formed under the corporation law of this state … shall obtain a certificate of authority for each profession named in the articles of incorporation … may offer and render … professional engineering … services in this state

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Government employees inspecting residential structures as part of official duties
Persons performing home inspections solely for lender construction monitoring
Property managers inspecting their own managed residential structures without separate compensation
Small public works projects below a specified expenditure threshold

Persons with grandfathered or legacy licensure status in discontinued engineering branch titles
Boundary surveys on private land not intended as basis for engineering design
Professional engineers or engineer interns granted inactive status
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person whose license is inactive shall not offer or practice professional engineering within this state, but may continue to use the title "professional engineer" or the initials "P.E." after such person's name.
